source.label: Beverly wallet database

metricDefinitions.name: Transactions
metricDefinitions.definition: Transactions count distinct purchase orders inside the selected reporting period.
metricDefinitions.calculationSummary: Count distinct purchase identifiers from 5 June through 2 September 2026.

metricDefinitions.name: Delivered revenue
metricDefinitions.definition: Delivered revenue sums purchase amounts whose final status is delivered.
metricDefinitions.calculationSummary: Sum delivered purchase amounts inside the selected reporting period.

metricDefinitions.name: Vendor breakdown
metricDefinitions.definition: Vendor breakdown groups vendor purchases using their reporting identity and site.
metricDefinitions.calculationSummary: Compare raw grouped purchases against the reporting function output.

caveats: Browser-managed downloads did not expose completion events to the automation channel.

evidenceFlow.title: Uniqueness
evidenceFlow.body: All 736 source rows had distinct purchase identifiers.

evidenceFlow.title: Completeness
evidenceFlow.body: No status, amount, station, or actor fields were missing.

evidenceFlow.title: Daily reconciliation
evidenceFlow.body: Daily totals summed to the same 736 transactions.

evidenceFlow.title: Vendor reconciliation
evidenceFlow.body: Raw vendor totals matched the reporting function exactly.

evidenceFlow.title: Schema readiness
evidenceFlow.body: All ten required announcement delivery columns were present.

preview.note: Independent aggregate checks against the live reporting pipeline.
